ratings.comment: Professor Opkins is average but super consistent. I took her for 3 different classes at CSULB and got a B every time easy. She gives a lot of work, but her labs and exams are often very easy. Everything is done in groups and although she does a poor job making directions if you clarify with her or have her check you're work you are guaranteed an A.

Mimi is a very mediocre professor. The difficulty in her class comes not from her assignments, which are often quite straightforward, but her extremely unclear grading criteria. It is very easy to lose points for things that were never specified as requirements in the first place.

Do not take if you dont understand the basics of java. If you have no other choice, read the book and speak to your classmates or u will fail. She teaches with the assumption that students know the basics of java (arrays, classes, inheritance, polymorphism, etc) projects are pretty easy, so was the midterm but her explaining is 2/5.

Don't take mimi. Assigns homework due 2 days apart during the week. Her lectures are absolutely horrible. Reads off of powerpoints, gets confused, and forgets what she was confused about. You won't learn MySql from her, you'll learn from your groupmates. Extremely picked grader - one mistake and you lose 1/5 of points. 4 midterms Take david brown.

Boring class, reads off slides. Shows lectures of other professors to make up for her ineptitude. Gives 2hrs to take 61 question final and a written portion which is time consuming. Extremely picky grader, docked points for things not on rubric. Homework is time consuming and due every few days. Term project is okay with good partners or suffer.

Terrible professor. She just reads off the lecture slides and when we moved to online because of the corona virus (Spring 2020), she is "teaching" us by playing videos from linkedin. Even worse, her grading criteria is very unclear for projects and exams. You can do everything she lists and still get marked off despite it not being mentioned.

One of the worst professors I have ever had. The project grading criteria is so unclear. You could do everything on the rubric and still get 70%. Do not take this professor if you can. Reads off slides. Tests are easy if you study slides but the fact that projects are graded based off requirements not explicitly stated, makes me want to commit.

Terrible at teaching the concept. Most students self-teach. Reads off slides. Can still get bad grade even if you meet requirements (grading is subjective and rubric is unclear). Unorganized. Too much theory-based teaching so projects are harder to do.

Lectures are read off the slides, much better off using the online resources she provides. Grading is unclear and is LITERALLY subjective,she decides an A based on performance and improvement level not just sheer points. HW 2 times every week so you have no time to ask for help. 2 mid w/ 1 partner project crammed in October cuz why not. Just Don't

The class is difficult but if anyone ask her questions, she can answer in-depth, otherwise she will go over the basics. As for the exams, she will tell the class what she expect and the class can review her PowerPoint Her grading is rather unclear but the class can ask her questions about it. Asking questions matter and she gives time for questions

Most of lecture is her reading off the power-points and or showing videos, but when the class is engaged and asks the right questions she shows that she has a lot more to offer as a teacher in terms of insight into the topic. All assignments are straightforward and she gives plenty of time in class to ask questions if you are confused.
very picky of what she wants in your project but doesn't specify anything boring lecture, she just reads from ppt and plays videos in class
Inconsistent grading, slideshow lectures, group projects.

4 Homework assignments, she is caring and funny during lectures. Its a good class if you want a run down on web development. Only thing I hated was the labs which are given half way through class and due by the end. Would take again.

Lectures are boring as she basically reads her powerpoint. The homework she gave aren't appropriate to learn (boring to do with no technical challenges whatsoever) She doesn't know much about her subject, when you ask question she will lookup for answers on her computer. The class I took was web development, she doesn't know about the latest trends

Very picky with grading. Lectures are boring because she reads off from her computer. No need to purchase the textbook because her ppts are on her website. Exams were so-so and final was not cumulative. I wouldn't take her again.

Chill lecturer, frequent homework but it's not long or difficult. Pretty helpful if you have questions and responds to emails quickly. Exams aren't super easy but she gives samples so you know what to expect. Only issue is that she's a bit too hands-off with teaching SQL, just goes over the basics but you'll definitely need more for this class.

After reading the reviews here I was a bit nervous taking her class, but turned out A LOT better than I had expected. Since it is an intro database class, she emphasizes more on concepts rather than SQL code. One downside is that there is a huge group project that is worth 2 midterms. She's very open and helpful and tests/hw are straightforward.

Pointless to go to lecture as she waste 40 minutes and lectures for 10.  Skipped class consistently and just read the online textbook provided on her website to self teach myself the UML & terms. Expect to learn a lot on your own. Don't expect to learn SQL from her. Her method is "here's a text file with a tutorial". Expects what she didn't ask for
Easily the worst professor I've ever had in my entire college career. She just reads off lecture slides and her tests are confusing as hell. Avoid her at all costs!!

Will look for any reason to dock points off of you, and will expect things out of your work that she does not tell you about. Her way of communicating what she wants is unclear. The class is boring and she just talks over a PowerPoint.

Probably the worst and least helpful professor I've had on campus. She gives no room for improvement and just sits during lecture expecting everyone to just glare at the PowerPoint slides. The exams were quite simple but don't expect to learn much from this course. She has no character and no motivation to wow her students. Never again.
Sits down during lecture, doesn't really explain well. Reads off powerpoints. Mainly do uml and relational schema problems. Barely teaches Sql.

Well, mimi gives tons of homework every week and grades them hard. Lectures are clear and everything is online. However, exams are doable but she is a tough grader. She doesn't curve and expect the final to be hard.  She takes points off wherever she can and expect the group projects to be graded hard. Overall extremely hard professor.

She is an extremely hard grader and expect tons of hard assignments. Labs are doable and she tries to take points off wherever  she can. She makes it as though she is fairly sweet but she IS NOT and she is extremely tough professor. She makes extremely hard finals. I  would never take her again.

Her expectations on responses are unclear. Her grading is extremely subjective. She words her questions terribly, and when you ask to her to clarify she still leaves stuff out that may cost you points. There's many correct ways to model a database, but it has to be the way she wants it and she makes assumptions that she won't tell you about. Bad.
The teacher is hard grader, no curves, lectures are long and boring, assignments are long, labs are a bit tough, and overall she is tough.

All lectures are on her website so no need to buy the textbook. Programs were fairly easily and doable the only problem was that she isn't very specific in her instructions so ASK her to look at your code before turning it in. Exams are pretty easy just review the power points and she gives hints on what to expect, final non cumulative.

absolutely the worst teacher i have ever had ! you do not learn anything in her class and even if you ask her a question, she would not help you. her lab projects are ridiculous. really easy but you don't know what she wants but doable. i wish i could take this class with more knowledgeable professor.

This class is pretty straightforward, but her lectures are terribly boring. She just reads off powerpoint slides and just sits there. You can not pay attention half the time and just read the powerpoint later and get the same exact information. You learn, but you could learn much more if she put in decent effort in teaching.

7 Chapter test - 20 MC questions, fairly easy if you understand the coding for it. Labs/Projects are really easy, if you need help you can email or bug her in class cause she would always help in my opinion. Gave some extra credit assignment. Helps to learn what the coding says, its very straightforward.

I'm a math major so I had to take this class, but it was not that bad. She tells us what she expects. If you are unsure about the projects just ask your peers if you are afraid to ask her. Also make sure to read the book if you would like to do well on the tests, which are worth more than the projects.
The class was very interesting, she finds people to come and guest lecture each week. Come to class and turn in your work and you'll be fine.

Mimi Opkins is not the best teacher that teaches a beginning java class... Avoid her at all cost!!!! She can be helpful at some times, but the majority of your projects are individual work, unless you get a good group that you can work with. You have a a test about every 1-2 weeks and a java code project due every 1-2weeks. GOOD LUCK.

Her teaching is not helpful. she basically teaches from the book and her lecture notes are same as the book, so just read the book and u get the same info.  she is very anal about her labs and if u are late or miss the class she wont accept the lab assignment from you.  also she isnt very helpful with lab or any issues u might have in programming.

Mimi mostly reads off her powerpoints, but exams are STRAIGHT from the book, overall very straightforward EASY class. she is very helpful if you ask for questions, but sometimes doesn't explain herself well. the text for this class is easy to follow and with her help there should be no problem getting an A in this course; had her for CS 100 and 174

If you are a weak programmer, you will learn much as Opkins dumbs the material down with childish examples. If you are looking for a challenge, you will not find it in this class, nor will you learn anything you couldn't have read in the textbook in the first place. That said, Opkins is enthusiastic. She wants you to succeed, and succeed you will.

Mimi does not teach you anything,She sits and reads off her power point, gives little to none examples so expect to teach your self the material.  She is a difficult grader. Test are hard, labs are difficult so are projects. Avoid taking her!!!

this professor is not that great at teaching, all she did was read over her notes in the powerpoint. the good thing is that all her lecture notes are on her website so you dont have to take notes. she is a nice person but a very bad professor, i dont think i learned anything in this class

If you ask for help, she's more than willing. Don't need to take notes, lecture notes on her site. It was more of a self-learning class. Although her lectures were straightforward, if you're not paying full attention, you'll get lost fast. I knew nothing about programming. But since it's the basics, you can learn it by yourself from the textbook.
Mimi is a good professor. YOU must READ in order to understand the concepts. Nothing too hard. Has reading quizzes for every chapter. I did bad in those and still managed to get a B.

Tons of experience. Will help you if you need it. If you know what you are doing, this is an easy A. However, if you wanted to get ahead and learn everything possible before moving up to 274, avoid her class. When my friends finished the course material and moved on to better things, my class was still doing Arrays, 100 level stuff.

Moral teacher who sticks to her principles. Any whiners are people who do not want to put the effort into practicing the concepts that she puts forth. She has a solid understanding of the content and is always willing to help. She is willing to explain anything for as long as it takes you to understand. What more do you need?

TERRIBLE INSTRUCTOR! I had a her a few years ago (I am a senior now) and if there was an award for Worst Teacher in the department, she would be my top nominee. She doesn't teach, she sits in her chair most of the time. She really needs to find another job that doesn't involve teaching.

Lectures are succinct and to the point. Homework assignments are generally short (except for 1-2 long ones) but hammer in concepts well. Test questions seem tricky at first until you think about what concepts need to be demonstrated. I joined the course a few weeks late and Mimi was very helpful in answering all my questions. Highly recommended.

Run, run, far away from this teacher.  She doesn't teach at all, you either learn on your own or ask her for help while she talk down on you, if you are an undergraduate student. Her exam are nothing like her ppt, but its mc, doesn't curve, many classmate got a 45%-60%. So makes sure you get perfect score on all project to get a C in the class.

She is try to act nice but gave LOW score without hesitation. She doesn't teach you how to do the assignment, all she does is read off the power point and gave you the assignment with no instruction. Only thing good about her is she will answer your email pretty quick. I drop CECS as a minor because I had a bad experience with CECS teaching style.

INCOMPETENT! Best describes this person's ability to teach. She DOES NOT know the material!! Sat on her chair 99% percent of time because she CANNOT teach. Tells students to ask questions but hesitates to respond. I feel unprepared after taking her class. AVOID AT ALL COSTS!! HORRIBLE "INSTRUCTOR". A complete WASTE of time...you WILL NOT learn.
Mimi can't teach ...she must stop teaching java....you have to teach yourself from the book
Completely clueless professor. Does nothing but read off the book. You need to teach yourself the material cause her lectures are boring and useless.
Teacher does a good job explaining a dry subject.  Tests can sometimes be difficult.

You is actually very helpful is go out of yourway to talk to her.  Many students refuse to do this and don't see to do this in many classes.  What kind of professor would offer to come in early to help just one student?? Not many.  Class is a lot of work, and a professional education.. Just don't mess around and expect to get by.
She's a nice person and willing to do what she can, but she is a PART-TIME lecturer. She just doesn't have much to offer. I didn't learn much from her at all. Not a teacher i would recommend.

Terrible Terrible Terrible!!!! This woman does not know java and yet she is teaching it. She shouldn't be teaching anything! I only put easy because she taught me nothing which I know will hurt me later down the road. RUN AWAY!!!

The class can be confusing in the beginning, since its learning by doing--essentially the more you practice the database concepts, the more you'll get it. Lectures come straight from a good website, but with examples and Q&A.  One major project in the end that takes time, but not difficult. Tests can be tricky, read carefully & combine ideas.
She reminds me of the accountant that killed Selena. This woman is bitter... She can't teach.
